title: Embed deterministic bundled font glyphs
description: Embed or outline every bundled font glyph used by the printable scene so PDF text appearance and metrics never depend on fonts installed on the user's system.
acceptanceCriteria: Every scene font resolves to a versioned bundled resource with documented redistribution rights
All used glyphs are embedded, subset-embedded, or outlined in the PDF
Missing glyphs or font bytes return named structured diagnostics rather than system-font fallback
Installed system fonts and network font availability cannot affect output
Parsed artifacts identify the expected embedded/subset font or path outlines
Scene metrics and renderer font resources are version-compatible

steps.details: Map application-owned font IDs and versions to local licensed font bytes, supported glyph coverage, and the metrics version consumed by scene layout.
Collect a stable set of glyphs from ordered scene text runs, validate coverage, and return diagnostics naming font ID and unsupported code points.
Use the selected library's deterministic embedding/subsetting or outlining path, disabling fallback to standard or system fonts.
Parse a generated artifact to confirm expected font resources or outlines and generate under differing system-font availability to confirm unchanged output.
Remove a required bundled font or request an unsupported glyph and assert generation returns a named diagnostic with no successful PDF result.

technicalNotes: Custom user fonts and external durable font URLs are out of scope.
Font subset tags and glyph ordering may need canonicalization for byte determinism.
